questions.text: Which of these fractions results in a terminating decimal?
A shopkeeper purchases a certain number of identical pens at a rate of Rs. 840 per dozen. He sells them at Rs. 75 per piece. Find how many pens he bought if his total profit is Rs. 240.
A glass ball is dropped into a cylindrical tank of diameter 24 cm partially filled with water. If the water rises by 2 cm, what is the radius of the ball?
The marked price of a table is Rs. 2,400, which is 20% above the cost price. It is sold at a discount of 15% on the marked price. Find the profit percentage.

In a hostel, the average age of 24 students was 16 years. Later, 6 students left and 6 new students joined. The average age of the new group became 15.5 years. If the average age of the 6 students who left was 19 years, find the average age of the 6 students who joined.

A quality control manager monitors defect rates in 3 different machines. The first machine produces items with an average defect rate of 2.5%, the second with 1.8%, and the third with 2.2%. If the total number of defective units from all three machines is 3.15, and each machine's total production was identical, find the overall defect percentage.

In a training institute, there are three types of mock tests. The average score of a student in the first and second test is 78.4. The average score in the second and third test is 81.6. The average of the first and third test is 76.8. Find the marks obtained in the second test.
P, Q, and R invest Rs. 25,000, Rs. 35,000, and Rs. 40,000, respectively, in a business. The profit at the end of the year is Rs. 40,000. What is Q's share of the profit?

A company increases the dimensions of a product box each day. On the first day, the box length is 2.1 cm, and each day, the length increases by 0.4 cm. What will be the length of the box on the 8th day?
What is the radius of the circumscribed circle for a triangle with sides 13, 20, 21 units?

Priya invested a certain sum at a simple interest of r% p.a. such that it amounts to 160% of itself in 4 years. Find the interest earned when Rs. 3500 is invested at a simple interest of r% p.a. for 3 years.

Rohan distributed 75% of his total money between Neha and Arjun in the ratio 4:5. Neha invested her share at 8% p.a. and Arjun at 7% p.a. simple interest for 5 years. If the difference in the interest earned by Arjun and Neha is Rs. 1,800, then what is the total amount Rohan had?
A rope rests against a vertical pole and makes an angle φ with the horizontal ground such that tan φ = 4/3. If the length of the rope is 20 meters, find the height at which the rope touches the pole.

A sum of Rs. 5,000 amounts to Rs. 6,050 in 4 years at a certain rate of interest, compounded annually. Find the amount received after 2 years when Rs. 1,800 are invested at the same rate of compound interest (compounded annually).
The ratio between the daughter and father is 1:4. After 8 years, the ratio of their age becomes 2:5. What are the ages of the daughter and father? 12

In a circle, chord PQ subtends an angle of 68° at the circumference at point R. A tangent is drawn at point P. If the angle between this tangent and chord PR is 35°, what is the measure of the angle subtended by the minor arc PR at the center of the circle?
A motorcycle and a scooter travel at speeds in the ratio of 7:4. The scooter covers a distance of 320 km in 8 hours. What is the time taken by the motorcycle to cover the same distance?
In a school, ratio of the boys to the girls is 7:4. If 15% of the boys and 30% of the girls fail an exam, what is the ratio of the number of boys who passed to the number of girls who passed?
If cosec(α) = sec(38°), what is the value of α?
If (√5)³ × 25² = 5ⁿ × 5√5, then what is the value of n?
If y = 2 + √5, find the value of y + 1/y.
The areas of two similar triangles are 8 cm² and 72 cm². If a side of the smaller triangle is 3 cm, what is the length of the corresponding side of the larger triangle?

A trapezoid is formed by cutting a smaller triangle from the top of a larger similar triangle. If the height of the smaller triangle is 2/5 of the height of the larger triangle, what is the ratio of the area of the trapezoid to the area of the larger triangle?
If x + y = 9 and xy = 18, calculate the value of x² + y².
If x + y = 10 and x - y = 6, find (x² + y²)/(x + y).
